title: Card
description: A container that groups related content and actions, composed of CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent and CardFooter.

support.notes: Header/content/footer slots, five variants, root and section padding, guarded interactive navigation and content animations. Native view/navigator behavior replaces polymorphic HTML tags. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Compare elevated, outlined, filled, ghost and glass cards with the same content structure.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors
custom-colors.description: Give a section its own colors with style (or className); leave out CardHeader or CardFooter to omit them.

animation.title: Content animation
animation.description: CardContent can play a fadeIn, slideIn or zoomIn entrance animation.

padded.title: Padded layout
padded.description: padding makes the card pad itself; sections sit flush, separated by spacing and a footer rule. Works with every variant, including filled and ghost.

interactive.title: Interactive cards
interactive.description: interactive adds hover and focus-visible feedback; as renders the card as a link or a button.

CardProps.children: Card content, usually CardHeader, CardContent and CardFooter
CardProps.padding: Pads the card itself (padded layout); omit it for the classic layout where each section pads itself
CardProps.interactive: Adds hover and focus-visible feedback for clickable cards
CardProps.as: Element or component rendered as the root, e.g. a, button or article
CardProps.type: Native type of the root when as="button"

CardHeaderProps.children: Header content, usually CardTitle and CardDescription
CardHeaderProps.padding: Overrides the inner spacing of this section

CardDescriptionProps.children: Secondary text shown below the title

CardContentProps.padding: Overrides the inner spacing of this section

CardFooterProps.padding: Overrides the inner spacing of this section

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Compose <minerva-card> with header (title + description), content and footer sections; omit a section to leave it out.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: default, outline, elevated, filled and ghost, here with the padded layout.

padded.title: Padding and animation
padded.description: padding on the card switches to the padded layout (sections sit flush); padding on a section overrides its own spacing. animation adds an entrance animation to the content.

interactive.title: Link and button cards
interactive.description: as="a" with href makes the whole card a link, as="button" a button (click the second card to toggle it); interactive adds hover and focus feedback.

methods.focus: Focuses the inner link or button of a link / button card, else the card itself.
